result.finding: No additional system packages explicitly installed in the Dockerfile. The container relies entirely on packages included in the eclipse-temurin:8-jre base image (Debian-based, includes JRE 8 and standard Debian utilities).
evidence: Dockerfile: no apt-get install, apk add, yum install, or dnf install commands found
Dockerfile final stage has only 1 COPY instruction and ENTRYPOINT — no package installation layer
All required runtime packages come from eclipse-temurin:8-jre base image (Debian JRE packages)
Build stage uses maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 which includes Maven + JDK — no additional packages installed
values: Package manager used: none (no additional packages)
